capabilities: Autocomplete issue mentions by typing gh# with a number or title words
Search issues across many repositories in one GitHub Project
Insert a markdown link to the picked issue
Rank previously linked issues higher in results
Show a hover card with issue state, labels, update time, and excerpt
extras: The personal access token is stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault; the README documents the exact token permissions needed and notes SSO authorization for organizations that use it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to autocomplete links to GitHub issues from a project board or preview issue details when hovering such links.
summary: GitHub issue mention autocomplete that searches a GitHub Project board via a gh# trigger, inserts markdown links, and shows hover previews.
